$comment: Pinned copy of the upstream VM provider's public API surface. Internal only:
nothing in this directory is served, bundled or documented publicly.
openapi.json is the unauthenticated public OpenAPI document, byte for byte.
sdk/ holds the type declarations (dist/**/*.d.ts) and package.json of the
upstream SDK and CLI npm package, byte for byte. The coverage test (S3a)
reads both; the scheduled refresh job opens a PR when either changes.
